purpose: This table is the cleaned FAA aircraft registry reference for tail numbers observed among 2013 New York City departures, feeding joins against flight-level fact tables to describe the aircraft operating each flight.
usage: Join on tailnum to attach aircraft attributes (manufacturer, model, year manufactured, engine type and count, seats, cruising speed) to flight records; consumers should expect and handle nulls in year_manufactured and especially speed_mph, which is populated for under 1% of rows.
limitations: speed_mph is null for 99.3% of rows (3299 of 3322) and year_manufactured is null for 2.1% of rows (70 of 3322); per the operator context, American Airlines and Envoy Air aircraft are entirely absent because those carriers reported fleet numbers rather than tail numbers in the source data, so this registry cannot describe their aircraft at all.
